notes.title: Kickstarter is LIVE!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45664396/a0dde54775e9dfe5df03cda57fc8efd8c1a92249.png"][/img]
Kickstarter campaign starts now and ends on September! If you want to contribute and receive some rewards, go get the Early Bird discounts before time runs out!

The rewards were planned to give the backer the oportunity to be part of the game itself:[/p][list][*][p]Write fortune cookies messages for the player to find.[/p][/*][*][p]Have an in-game monument.[/p][/*][*][p]Become a deity and bless the player during their run.[/p][/*][*][p]Help decide on a character skin together with the other backers.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're interested, go check it out on Kickstarter! There are Early Bird discounts for early backers available until August 15th.

Here's the link: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kalann/jackpot-dungeon"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kalann/jackpot-dungeon[/url][/p]

notes.title: Jackpot Dungeon on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h1]Jackpot Dungeon on Kickstarter![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45664396/72ddb9d35eaab162e55bd94e493f2e6d73950369.png"][/img]

[b]Jackpot Dungeon will be live on Kickstarter on the second half of July![/b] [/p][p]If you want to help us make it happen or even be part of the game universe, consider checking it out!

You can already see the project on Kickstarter here:
[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kalann/jackpot-dungeon?ref=e44r1n"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kalann/jackpot-dungeon?ref=e44r1n[/url]

We are preparing some special rewards for the backers that will allow them to leave their mark on the game, as well as some very interesting overshoot milestones. [/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested, don't forget to click on "Notify me on launch" to stay updated![/p]
